_comment: oracmux pre-send guard. 2026-11-10: markers are empty on purpose (利用者「そのガード不要です」: 社外秘・NDA などの語では送り出しを止めない)。If markers are listed again they block the send unless --allow-markers; deny_roots block unconditionally; max_total_chars caps the brief. Keep the markers_ja / markers_ascii keys present and empty: a removed key falls back to the code default (10 marker words), and a missing guard.json stops every send (exit 7).
